count_min: 180 explicit coefficient/weighted stream cases; zero matrices force collisions; every row and 64 point queries checked
hyperloglog: All precision folds from p4..8, zero/ones hashes, duplicate zero and 20 deterministic corpora per pair; synthetic rank vectors cover all correction branches
minhash: All 120 permutations of five elements across every pair of the 32 subsets, then ordered ten-permutation banding counterexamples
limits: Finite deterministic observations and an exhaustive tiny hash-family experiment do not prove statistical quality for production hash generators.
